# ViTamin

**Category:** Hybrid · **Code:**
[`timm/models/vitamin.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/vitamin.py) ·
**Architectures:** 13 · **Pretrained weights:** 15 (0 with ImageNet-1k results)

ViTamin is a vision model designed for vision-language models, with convolutional (MBConv) stages followed by
transformer stages. The weights are CLIP image towers.

## Papers

* [ViTamin: Designing Scalable Vision Models in the Vision-Language Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.02132)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('vitamin_base_224.datacomp1b_clip', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

✓ supported, ✓ (square) works for square sizes only, ✗ not supported, – not needed (the model already accepts any input
size). Checked by running each feature on a randomly initialized model (`VisionTransformer` with `vitamin_small_224` at
224), other architectures of the same class are expected to behave the same. See the [Model API](../model_api) page for
details.

the listed eval size, - if the weight has no ImageNet-1k result (e.g. pretraining or image-text weights). Classes is the
